name: Debian APT
auth: Use an access or reference token as the HTTP Basic password, with AW_USER equal to its subject. The subject needs read permission for installation and deploy permission for publication on the selected repository; token scopes cannot exceed that identity. The same clients also accept a user password when Basic password authentication is enabled. Use HTTPS.
fresh_home: Run in a newly created disposable pinned Ubuntu container and create AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d) inside it. Both the dpkg database and APT caches must be fresh; a fresh HOME alone is insufficient.
prerequisites: A new Linux amd64 Ubuntu container; installation requires root inside that disposable container.
Signed repository metadata and the corresponding trusted public key.
AW_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY names the operator-verified ASCII-armored public key file; no private key belongs in the client container.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/lists/partial" "$AW_WORK/archives/partial"
cp "$AW_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY" "$AW_WORK/debian.asc"
printf 'deb [signed-by=%s/debian.asc] %s/artifactory/%s stable main\n' "$AW_WORK" "$AW_URL" "$AW_REPO" > "$AW_WORK/sources.list"
printf 'machine %s login %s password %s\n' "$AW_URL" "$AW_USER" "$AW_TOKEN" > "$AW_WORK/auth.conf"
chmod 0755 "$AW_WORK" "$AW_WORK/lists" "$AW_WORK/archives"
chmod 0644 "$AW_WORK/debian.asc" "$AW_WORK/sources.list"
chmod 0600 "$AW_WORK/auth.conf"
chown _apt:root "$AW_WORK/lists/partial" "$AW_WORK/archives/partial"
configure.note: Run this entire recipe inside a fresh disposable Ubuntu container. Verify the operator-provided public key before importing it. auth.conf is temporary and mode 0600. The public signing key and its parent directory are readable/traversable by the _apt sandbox; only the credential file stays private. Partial download directories belong to _apt.

publish.note: Publish to a local or one-node federated repository. Remote repositories are read-through caches; select the local deployment member when reading through a virtual.

steps.note: The repository must have a signing key assigned. Matrix parameters select distribution, component and architecture.

install.note: Select a local, remote, virtual or one-node federated repository with read permission. Dependencies must also be available through that repository.

steps.note: APT still installs into the container system root: never run this install example on the host. The container must run as root.

limitations: The example is stable/main/amd64. Change distribution/component/architecture consistently.
Fresh container state is required in addition to fresh lists and archive directories.

contains: apt installs a signed package from a <class> repository
